scientific_integrity: The paper proves the all-parameter character; finite exact checks independently corroborate selected cases. Originality is a best-knowledge comparison, not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: New contribution is the full simultaneous S_m × S_n rational homology character and diagonal S_3 quotient. Previously available target-color character and full-color quotient acyclicity, and the Babson–Kozlov sphere type, are not new. No integral action, equivariant wedge splitting, or contractibility is asserted; bibliographic equivalent formulas remain possible.
title: The complete joint permutation character of complete-graph Hom complexes
